entries.title: Cloud-to-Rain Cycle in a Mini Atmosphere Box
entries.description: A transparent box containing floating vapor particles that slowly condense into clustered droplets inside a semi-transparent cloud volume, then detach and fall as raindrops onto a textured ground plane, forming shallow puddles that grow and ripple on impact.

entries.title: Raindrop Formation on a Cooling Metal Plate
entries.description: A horizontal, slightly tilted metallic plate above a heat source with rising warm vapor particles that cool, attach as tiny droplets, merge into larger drops that slide and leave wet trails before dripping off the edge into a collecting tray with a filling-level meter.

entries.title: Snowflake Growth and Descent
entries.description: Hexagonal seed crystals suspended in a cold transparent chamber that grow branching arms as vapor particles attach to them, then slowly fall with tumbling rotation, colliding and bouncing softly off a textured ground covered by an accumulating, height-varying snow layer.

entries.title: Thunderstorm Cell with Updrafts and Downdrafts
entries.description: A tall atmospheric column where warm air parcels rise in spiraling tubes, water droplets condense into a darkening cloud, merge into heavier raindrops that fall in concentrated shafts, some evaporating midair, with colored arrows and labels for updraft, downdraft, and precipitation intensity.

entries.title: Hailstone Layering Inside a Storm Cloud
entries.description: Spherical ice pellets circulate inside a rotating cloud volume, repeatedly lifted and dropped by animated vertical wind tubes, freezing new transparent layers each cycle, then finally falling out as multi-layered hailstones that bounce and roll across the ground on impact.

entries.title: Orographic Rain Over a Mountain Ridge
entries.description: A moving air mass represented by drifting particle clouds approaches a 3D mountain range, rises along the slope, condenses into denser clouds that produce rain on the windward side, while the leeward side stays dry, with color-coded humidity and rainfall intensity on the terrain.

entries.title: Urban Rainfall and Runoff System
entries.description: A city block with roofs, roads, and drains where falling raindrop particles hit surfaces, some sticking as puddles that grow and merge, while others flow as shallow streams toward storm drains, tracked by colored flow lines and an animated gauge showing runoff volume over time.

entries.title: Microscopic Crystal Precipitation in a Beaker

entries.title: Formation of Stalactites from Dripping Mineral Water

entries.title: Precipitation as a Resource in a Watershed Model
